incident-bot: PagerDuty alert for org "Cascade" (org_id: cascade-42) — p95 latency spike + 5xx increase on inference endpoints. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cascade-prod (alert: cascade-inference-high-latency). Paging on-call.
Alex: Taking this. Initial triage: errors concentrated on /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate. Error rate ~3.2%, p95 latency from ~420ms -> ~1.1s. Traffic looks bursty from a small set of client tokens.
Priya: Can we do a quick mitigation: temporary org-level burst bump and route-based shaping to prioritize streaming chat? Also suggest disabling rich_previews FF for Cascade — those previews spawn rendering and are CPU heavy.
Alex: Agree. Applying emergency override: burst_multiplier=3, sustained_qps +25%, set route-priority for /v1/chat/stream to high, deprioritize embeddings routes. Flip rich_previews -> false.
Alex: Running admin API ops now:
```
# emergency overrides
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/orgs/cascade-42/overrides" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"burst_multiplier":3,"sustained_pct":125,"reason":"emergency spike mitigation","expires_at":1729992000}'

# disable rich previews for this org
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/orgs/cascade-42/feature-flags" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"rich_previews":false,"reason":"reduce CPU during spike"}'
```
Casey: Looping AE Tom in so customer-facing team knows. Tom, heads up — we applied a short-lived mitigation, will follow up with timeline to revert. @Tom
Tom: Got the DM, thank you. Please keep me posted before any longer extension so I can coordinate with Cascade ops.
Jamie: Quick Q — do we need to throttle any non-critical background jobs on Cascade side (webhooks/retry workers)? Those often cause bursts that amplify token QPS.
Alex: Good point. Adding a temporary debounce on outbound webhooks for Cascade via routing rule (60s). Also limiting webhook concurrency to 2 per org for the next 20 minutes. Pushing changes.
deploy-bot: admin override applied (change-id: ov-9c2b1). Feature flag update applied (ff-change: ff-43d). Route priorities updated. Logs/trace: https://deploys.redwood/ov-9c2b1
Alex: Post-mitigation snapshot: p95 latency down to ~320ms, error rate ~0.5% and falling. Host CPU on affected pool reduced ~16%.
Nate: Taking handoff from Alex. I'll monitor for 30m and watch error budgets, autoscaler flapping, and any model fallback events. If everything stable at expiry (1729992000) we'll let the automated revert run; otherwise will request SRE lead approval to extend.
cs-signal-bot: AE Tom notified via DM/email. Support ticket CS-4891 created to inform customer and ask whether they can dampen client retries.
Alex: Handoff note: mitigation summary: change-id ov-9c2b1, ff ff-43d, webhook debounce +60s, route-priority applied. Revert scheduled 1729992000. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/cascade-emergency-mitigation
Nate: Ack. I'll post a brief status update to #incidents in 15m with updated metrics and whether webhook debounce reduced origin bursts.
